description: TXN-STMT through the ACE OLE DB provider (the DAO lane is qualified). Process a holds a pessimistic DAO Edit on row 40 (the middle candidate, on its own page); process b runs, on an ADODB.Connection with the event sink, UPDATE T SET V = V + 1 WHERE ID IN (1, 20, 40, 64) with RecordsAffected passed by reference (typed VT_BYREF|VT_I4 starting at -9) and adExecuteNoRecords, then the same inside an ADO BeginTrans, reads the rows, and finally a cancels the Edit and b repeats. Asks the ADO error number and wait, whether the unblocked candidates change, and what ADO writes into the by-reference RecordsAffected.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
